Solara — (9.8) SOLSTICE

NEGATIVE POLARITY

"Negative polarity"

[Verse 1]

The gate was at the back.

(not the front gate)

(the back gate)

(there is a difference)

Void placed his hand on it.

(his crew is from level negative forty-five)

(he knows this gate)

The gate did not open.

Void says That is new.

Solara says What is new.

Void says It does not know me.

Solara says It always knew you.

Void says Something changed.

(he did not elaborate)

(he never elaborates)

(this was consistent)

Aldric checked his notes.

(Day One — back gate — recognized VOID — correct)

(the note was from a long time ago)

(the note was now wrong)

(he noted that the note was wrong)

Something moved in the dark behind the gate.

[Solara:] What is that.

[Void:] The guardian.

[Solara:] The guardian of Level negative one.

[Void:] Yes.

[Solara:] What does it look like.

[Void:] It has changed as well.

Negative polarity

Negative polarity

Negative polarity

Sheep body.

Earthworm — multiple segments.

Butterfly wings.

(nobody moved)

(for a moment)

(nobody moved)

[Aldric:] Yes.

[Void:] It was different before.

(a pause)

[Void:] It was worse before.

[Solara:] This is worse than the previous version.

[Void:] Yes.

The butterfly wings opened.

(this was the alarming part)

(not the goat)

(not the earthworm)

(the wings)

Aldric produced something from his coat.

(a note)

(of course a note)

[Aldric:] The note says aim for the second earthworm segment.

[Solara:] Why the second.

(the note had never been wrong)

First time.

Void on the left.

Solara on the right.

They did not need to discuss this.

they did not discuss this

Void moved left

Solara moved right

this was the whole discussion

Aldric stayed back.

[Aldric:] Second segment. Now.

[Aldric:] Wings come next. Three seconds.

[Aldric:] The sheep portion is load-bearing. Do not hit the sheep portion.

[Solara:] Why not the sheep.

[Aldric:] It will multiply.

(Solara did not hit the sheep portion)

Void moved through the earthworm segments.

(not fast)

(not slow)

(once)

(she hit it again)

(he noted this)

(Void looked at the wings)

(the wings looked at Void)

(the chimera had not accounted for what Void is)

Negative polarity

Aldric filed the updated note.

Chimera defeated.

Day One.
